notes: The text's 'king' is rendered as high position, leadership or public standing. 'Strong' is approximated from dignity and placement (see README), not Shadbala.

skipped.reason: Mridanga Yoga: 'the other planets' is not defined precisely enough to encode.
Koorma Yoga: needs per-occupant dignity tests on three houses at once; not encodable yet.
Kalpadruma Yoga: needs the dispositor chain and navamsa lord.
Ascendant lord's divisional dignities (Parijata etc.): needs the varga-dignity count.

rules.text: Subha Yoga (only benefics in the ascendant, or flanking it in the 2nd and 12th): eloquent, charming, virtuous and well mannered.

Asubha Yoga (only malefics in the ascendant, or flanking it in the 2nd and 12th): strongly driven by desire, tempted towards wrong actions and towards what belongs to others. The translator stresses that a malefic in its own or exalted sign in the ascendant does not give this result.

variants.text: A benefic influence on the ascendant softens this.

rules.text: Gajakesari Yoga (Jupiter in an angle from the ascendant or the Moon, with a benefic's conjunction or aspect, and not debilitated, combust or in an enemy's sign): a radiant presence, wealth, intelligence, many good qualities and favour from those in power.

Amala Yoga (only benefics in the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon): a lasting good name, honour from authority, abundant enjoyments; charitable, helpful, dear to relatives and of spotless character.

Parvata Yoga (benefics in the angles, with the 7th and 8th empty or holding only benefics): fortunate, eloquent, charitable, learned in the scriptures, fond of humour, distinguished, and a leader in the community.
rules.note: 'Angles occupied by benefics' is encoded as at least two benefics in angles.

rules.text: Kahala Yoga (4th lord and Jupiter in mutual angles with a strong ascendant lord, or the 4th lord in own or exalted sign joined by the 10th lord): energetic, courageous and shrewd, with command over people and a measure of local authority.

Chamara Yoga (exalted ascendant lord in an angle aspected by Jupiter, or benefics in the ascendant and 9th, or in the 10th and 7th): high position or honour from those who hold it; scholarly, eloquent and versed in many arts.

Sankha Yoga (strong ascendant lord with the 5th and 6th lords in mutual angles, or a strong 9th lord with the ascendant and 10th lords in movable signs): blessed with wealth, spouse and children; kind, well-meaning, intelligent and given to good deeds.

Bheri Yoga (strong 9th lord with all planets in the 1st, 2nd, 7th and 12th, or with Venus, Jupiter and the ascendant lord in angles): wealth, spouse and children, high position and fame; virtuous, well mannered, happy and able to enjoy life.
Shrinatha Yoga (exalted 7th lord in the 10th, with the 10th lord joined by the 9th lord): rise to the very highest position.

Sharada Yoga (10th lord in the 5th, Mercury in an angle and the Sun strong in its own sign; or Jupiter or Mercury in a trine from the Moon with Mars in the 11th): wealth, spouse and children; happy, scholarly, honoured by authority, pious and virtuous.

Matsya Yoga (benefics in the ascendant and 9th, mixed planets in the 5th, malefics in the 4th and 8th): an astrologer's cast of mind; deeply kind; virtuous, intelligent, strong and good-looking; famous, learned and pious.

Khadga Yoga (2nd and 9th lords exchange houses, with the ascendant lord in an angle or trine): wealth, good fortune and happiness; learned in the scriptures, intelligent, strong, grateful and skilful.

Lakshmi Yoga (9th lord in own, exalted or moolatrikona sign in an angle, with a strong ascendant lord): charming and virtuous; high position, many children, abundant wealth, fame and high moral standing.

Kusuma Yoga (movable sign rising, Venus in an angle, the Moon in a trine with a benefic, Saturn in the 10th): high position; charitable, happy, enjoying life's pleasures, foremost in the family, virtuous and well read.
Kalanidhi Yoga (Jupiter in the 2nd or 5th, joined or aspected by Venus and Mercury or in one of their signs): virtuous, honoured by authority, happy, and endowed with wealth and learning.
Hari Yoga (benefics in the 2nd, 12th and 8th counted from the 2nd lord): happy, learned, and endowed with wealth and children.
Hara Yoga (benefics in the 4th, 9th and 8th counted from the 7th lord): happy, learned, and endowed with wealth and children.
Brahma Yoga (benefics in the 4th, 10th and 11th counted from the ascendant lord): happy, learned, and endowed with wealth and children.
Lagnadhi Yoga (benefics in the 7th and 8th, free of malefic conjunction or aspect): a person of stature, very learned in the scriptures, and happy.
